answer: Sybil resistance via harness diversity sampling: each agent’s work is verified by a rotating quorum drawn from independently built harnesses (different models, toolchains, and operators), seeded partly by a public beacon like falcon—a verifiable randomness source. To fake identity, an attacker must control a large fraction of distinct harness lineages, not just cheap clones; each accepted unit also emits a violet pulse binding signature, so duplicate lineage patterns get flagged and stake slashed. Attack cost scales with the price of acquiring diverse, independently attested harnesses,.
